method: Frozen image capture followed by source comparison and native bands; same-model second pass with prior exposure.
rejected_blind_readings: Native retains שנתם, ואדנך, דוק, פתחון, לנקותם, הנחלה, הנשברת and מצחן; reject frozen שתם/וארונך/חוק/פתחן/לנקובים/השפרת.
unresolved: Fine pointing and להתעודדה/להתעורדה unresolved; retain working form pending independent inspection. Shared concluding Makhnise range not a new source poem.
